python-lief `0.17.6` -> `1.0.0`

GCC 16 now available.

<previous_description>
{
 "summary": "Updates the Guix time-machine commit and bumps associated toolchain dependencies in the deterministic build manifests and CI. It updates CMake to 4.3.3, binutils to 2.47, and lief to 1.0.0 while reverting custom osslsigncode definitions back to upstream Guix packages. It also configures CMake link-warning-as-error options, disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc, and skips psutil test suites during lief packaging.",
 "problem": "The Guix build environment lags behind upstream Guix package updates, missing newer compiler and toolchain versions like GCC 16 and Clang 22/23. Furthermore, building on RISC-V systems fails due to failing psutil test suites and older Guix package revisions.",
 "card": "Updates the Guix time-machine commit to a newer upstream revision, bumping binutils to 2.47, CMake to 4.3.3, and lief to 1.0.0. The update keeps deterministic release build environments up to date and unblocks building natively on RISC-V systems (fixing issue #36232). Additionally, it cleans up custom local package definitions such as osslsigncode in favor of upstream Guix packages and adopts CMake-native linker warning flags.",
 "dependencies": {

 }
}
